text:
meera: CI is failing on the image-publish job after my Dockerfile tweak (reordered multistage). Getting checksum/manifest errors from the registry. cc @david @sam — can someone quick-check?

meera: logs excerpt:
```
[14:02:11] uploading layer sha256:def456 chunk 3/8
[14:02:12] ERROR: blob upload failed: checksum mismatch (expected sha256:abc123, got sha256:def456)
[14:02:12] manifest PUT https://registry.internal/v2/redwood/rlib/manifests/stable -> 500
```

meera: this only started after the base image digest updated yesterday — but not 100% sure if that's the cause.

david: which pipeline/job exactly? full job id and registry?

meera: main CI -> publish-image (run-9876), pushing to staging.registry.redwood.local. only linux-x86_64 runners failing; mac/arm not used for publish.

sam: hunch: registry-side stale cache or objectstore corruption. quick tries: did you try `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache` and push? also `docker push --disable-content-trust` sometimes bypasses trust checks.

meera: tried `--no-cache` locally, same checksum mismatch. tried manual `skopeo copy` -> failed with same checksum. reran CI once -> same.

ci-bot: run-9876 rerun=2; last successful publish for this image: 2026-03-15T10:12:09Z (run-9821).

david: any recent registry changes? storage node maintenance?

ops-bot: I see registry-proxy errors around that time: "blob write failed: checksum verification failed for blob sha256:def456 on storage-node-3". Could be a transient write corruption on objectstore. I'm restarting registry-proxy and invalidating transient cache on node-3 now.

meera: rebuilding now with `--no-cache` and unique tag `meera/test-20260316` to rule out tag races.

meera: update — pushing the rebuilt image with the test tag succeeded from my laptop. The pipeline still fails when it tries to push the same tag as part of the normal flow.

sam: that smells like a tagging/manifest race in CI. Try forcing single concurrent upload: `docker push --max-concurrent-uploads=1` (workaround we've used for flaky registries). Also try toggling `--compress` in build.

meera: ran `docker push --max-concurrent-uploads=1` locally against staging.registry and it worked. Will patch CI publish step to add `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` and set `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1` as a short-term fix.

david: please open a bisect ticket for the root cause (registry vs baseimage vs Dockerfile change). We should run a binary search over the last ~10 publishes to see where it started. I can help run the bisect tomorrow.

meera: opening INFRA ticket now with logs + commands + successful manual push notes: #INFRA-1247. Adding @eng-sre for storage verification. Thanks for the help :thumbsup:

ops-bot: I've kicked off objectstore checksum scan for storage-node-3 and will follow up in the ticket if I find underlying corruption. If scans come back clean, we should escalate to registry vendor.

sam: nice triage. For the patch: add `--max-concurrent-uploads=1` + `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1` to the publish job and include a `retry: 2` on push step.

meera: will land the hotfix and monitor. If push still flakes, I'll ask for a manual bisect run with @david. Thanks all — will update INFRA-1247 when hotfix lands. :tada:
